scenario: AITA for Getting Mad Over a Rock? | I went for a hike in a wildlife/nature preserve with my husband. We were admiring various rocks along the way. He was being stealthy about it, carrying it alongside his body in such a way as to hide it from the caretaker of the preserve, who we passed on the way out, so he knew it wasn't something he should do openly. I told him that it was a preserve, and that he should be taking nothing out of it. He claimed he "wanted to study it." (No, he's not a geologist.) Now this rock is going to sit around in our garage forever. He is never going to look at it again, but every time I see it I'm going to remember that he wouldn't leave it where it belonged. I get that it's just a rock, but it is part of the ecosystem, and it should be there for others to enjoy. It belongs at the preserve. Am I wrong for being irritated that he took it?
